page.overview:
Who is Giant Centipede?

This giant centipede was a summon of Nagato.

This giant centipede summon had a number of body piercings, most notable the one sticking through its head, and the Rinnegan, implying it was being controlled by Pain. Its face and legs were orange.

Though not much was seen of its abilities, though it did use its large body to demolish buildings in Konohagakure.

It was summoned during Pain's attack on Konoha to wreak havoc on the village and cause confusion. It was however killed by a single punch from Sakura Haruno. In the anime 3 of them existed, one of which was killed by Shikamaru.
